task: put the bowl on the stove

windows.text: Hold the empty gripper above the bowl on the table.
Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the metal bowl beside the bottle.
Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the metal bowl beside the bottle.
Approach the metal bowl from above, bringing the open gripper down toward it.
Approach the metal bowl from above, bringing the open gripper down over its center.
Approach the metal bowl from above, bringing the open gripper down toward its center.
Grasp the metal bowl from the table, closing the gripper around it.
Lift the metal bowl up off the table, away from the black bottle.
Grasp the metal bowl from the table and lift it up.
Lower the bowl down onto the stove burner.
Release the bowl onto the stove burner.
Open the gripper and readjust above the bowl on the stove.
